intro: Reduction targets with live progress against committed emissions.
name: Name
coverageHint: Declare the baseline and target for the scopes named here. Progress is read from Scope 1 and 2, so a baseline that includes Scope 3 would misstate it.
pickRequired: Pick a subsidiary and enter a target name.
invalidNumbers: Enter both years as four digits and both tCO₂e values as numbers.
emptyManage: Add a target to track progress against committed emissions.
emptyView: A super_admin can define reduction targets.
nonAuthoritative: Behind this progress, figures that rest on placeholder (demo) or other non-authoritative factors: {count} of {of}.
notCovered: Not covered — Scope 3 is outside the inventory's total, so this target has no progress to read.
noProgress: Progress is not yet available — no committed figure for a year after the {year} baseline, in the scopes this target reads.
